'''Roggwarts''' were large predatory beasts. A distinguishing anatomical feature were a pair of curving horns growing from the sides of their heads. They had a long tail and thick skin. [[Gor/Legends|Gor]] was a pet roggwart owned by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biology==
Roggwarts were large, horned creatures native to [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]], where they are natural enemies of the [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]]. The roggwart's evolutionary adaptation made it ideally suited for taking on single foes, since it rarely encounters more than one acklay at a time. A roggwart standed on its hind legs and used its sharp fangs, wicked claws, and thick tail to subdue its prey. A roggwarts was not terribly cunning, but it was difficult to surprise, retaining its predatory instincts even in captivity.<ref name="gaw" />

==History==
[[File:RoggwartAttack-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A roggwart attacks clone troopers]]

Roggwarts were believed to be a natural offshoot of the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] species, were created from them through [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic tinkering]], or the two just happen to look similar due to convergent evolution.<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> 

After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] defeated the Bitthævrians in the [[Invasion of Guiteica]], many Kaleesh warriors took baby roggwarts as trophies. Following the [[Bitthævrian War|Kaleesh-Bitthævrian War]], nearly every Kaleesh [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] owned at least one or two roggwarts as watch-guardians or pets.<ref name="TCWEG" />   

By the times of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Lair of Grievous" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had obtained<ref name="gaw" /> and kept a pet roggwart<ref name="Lair of Grievous" /> native from [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> named [[Gor/Legends|Gor]] in his [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] on [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek's]] [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]].<ref name="Lair of Grievous" /> Gor was roughly the size of a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], and was outfitted with battle armor, including a chest plate with mechanical arms, and helmet. He was released to attack [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], his former padawan, [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]], and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]], in Grievous' castle. In the end, Gor was defeated by [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in Grievous' own home.<ref name="Lair of Grievous" />
